decisionsTitle: The V2.20 nits: «Dificultate» and «Treapta» on one axis, «Pagini» keeps its reader, the public menu in the owner's order
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-28**, with a screenshot of «Ce fel de eveniment»: «partea asta nu e centrată!» — and, of «Pagini» → «Contact»: «când dau click pe pagina de contact mă duce automat la Setări... ar trebui să rămân în același loc». And of the public menu: Evenimente · Calendar · Contact · Echipa · Întrebări frecvente, then the custom pages.

**«Dificultate» and «Treapta» on one axis.** The band select and the step toggle are one grid, `DifficultyRow`, on the create page and in the editor alike (§406). The toggle's label is a legend in the outline's edge, drawn like the select's shrunk label, so both visible outlines are 56 pixels on the same line; the row aligns to the cells' top, so a refused save's helper text under the select never moves the toggle off the axis. The step column is `max-content` and the help line wraps inside it, so the band select keeps the rest of the width. The end-to-end spec reads the three segments' own words rather than the group's whole text, which now carries the legend.

**«Pagini» keeps its reader.** «Contact» was the one entry of «Pagini»'s row that left the section: it opened «Setări» → «Contact» (§516), the main bar lit «Setări» and the row was gone. The page and its two server actions move unchanged to `/admin/pages/contact` — the same two cards, the same gates (`canReadContent` at the page, `canManageClubSettings` at each action and service) — and `/admin/settings/contact` answers 308 there through the moved-paths table, query and fragment kept. «Contact» leaves «Setări»'s tab row: one page, one way in (§520). The row is data (`PAGES_ROW_ROUTE`, `pagesRowEntryOf` in `modules/content/pages/pages-row.ts`); the main bar's longest-href rule is the pure `activeAdminTabHref`. «Sarcini» → «Club»'s contact row, the guide, the task steps and `SETUP.md` / `CLAUDE.md` name «Pagini → Contact».

**The review's round.** The club's own pages' editors (`/admin/pages/new`, `/admin/pages/<id>`) now draw «Pagini»'s row too, with «Paginile clubului» marked — `pagesRowEntryOf` already mapped them to it — so the reader stays in the section on every address under it. The `/admin/pages` list's layout gate was `isEditorial` (Organizer and up) while the «Pagini» tab and the list page ask `canReadContent` (Redactor and up), so a Redactor pressed the tab into a 404; the layout asks `canReadContent` now, still on the server and still above the `loading.tsx` boundary so the refusal stays a real 404. The writes keep their own gates: reordering and deleting assert `canEditEventFields`, which a Redactor lacks, and the list draws the move arrows only for a role the move accepts, rather than offering a Redactor an arrow the server refuses.

**Each row's ⋮ offers only what its service accepts.** The second review found the menu still gated on `canEditTexts` alone, so a Redactor was shown «Șterge», which `deletePage` refuses (`canEditEventFields`), and «Publică» / «Retrage», which `transitionPage` refuses under the Administrator (`TRANSITIONS`). One pure function, `pageListVerbs` (`modules/content/pages/page-list-verbs.ts`), answers per role and status: «Editează» for `canEditTexts`, «Publică» / «Retrage» only where `canTransition` allows that move from the row's status, «Șterge» only for `canEditEventFields`; the list draws each item and its hidden form only when the verb is offered, and the server still asserts every press. A side effect worth naming: `TRANSITIONS` has no DRAFT → PUBLISHED row, so a draft's row no longer offers «Publică» to anyone — the server refused that press for every role already; a draft page is submitted for review from its own editor and then published by an Administrator (the plain table, as §423 left standing pages).

**The public menu's order.** One list decides it — `SECTIONS` in `SiteNav`, which the header's row and its ☰ menu both draw; the footer's fold carries its own links, not this list. It reads «Evenimente · Calendar · Contact · Echipa · Întrebări frecvente», then the rule and the club's own pages in their own order (§251 had Contact last of the platform's sections). The two conditional sections keep their relative slots: «Galerie» (while an album is published, §66) just before «Echipa», «Membri» (§524) right after «Întrebări frecvente». Contact moving to third also serves §262, which wanted it on a phone's row beside the first two. A unit test pins the rendered order; the header spec asserts the first three.
changelogLine: - **The V2.20 nits** — «Dificultate» and «Treapta» centred on one axis in the event editor; «Pagini» → «Contact» (now `/admin/pages/contact`, the old address a 308) and the club's own pages' editors keep «Pagini»'s row; a Redactor reaches the pages list and its ⋮ offers only what the server accepts; the public menu reads Evenimente · Calendar · Contact · Echipa · Întrebări frecvente, then the club's pages. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The event editor's «Dificultate» select and «Treapta» toggle are one row whose two 56-pixel outlines share one centre line, on the create page and in the editor alike, and a refused save's helper text does not move the toggle (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Every entry of «Pagini»'s row — «Contact», «Echipa», «Întrebări frecvente», «Membri», «Paginile clubului» — opens an address under `/admin/pages`, the main bar keeps «Pagini» lit on each, the row marks the entry the address names, including on `/admin/pages/new` and one page's editor, and `/admin/settings/contact` answers 308 to `/admin/pages/contact` (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A Redactor who is offered the «Pagini» tab reaches the `/admin/pages` list — its layout asks `canReadContent` on the server as the page does — and each row's ⋮ offers a role only the verbs its service accepts: «Editează» for `canEditTexts`, «Publică» / «Retrage» only where the editorial table lets that role make the move, «Șterge» and the move arrows only for `canEditEventFields`, so a Redactor edits a page but is shown neither delete, publish, unpublish nor reorder (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The public menu — the header's row and its ☰ menu, from one list — reads Evenimente, Calendar, Contact, then «Galerie» while an album is published, Echipa, Întrebări frecvente, «Membri» while its page is on the site, then the club's own pages in their own order (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Dificultate» and «Treapta» on one axis, «Pagini» keeps its reader, the public menu in the owner's order
